text:
A certain element has several isotopes.
Which statement about these isotopes is correct?
A
They must have different numbers of electrons orbiting their nuclei.
B
They must have the same number of neutrons in their nuclei.
C
They must have the same number of nucleons in their nuclei.
D
They must have the same number of protons in their nuclei.

options.label: A
options.text: They must have different numbers of electrons orbiting their nuclei.

options.label: B
options.text: They must have the same number of neutrons in their nuclei.

options.label: C
options.text: They must have the same number of nucleons in their nuclei.

options.label: D
options.text: They must have the same number of protons in their nuclei.
